note: Real measurements taken outside a full run.sh sweep (e.g. container image size obtained by pulling the official image and reading the `docker images` uncompressed size). Every entry cites its method and date. These are folded into results.json with provenance=measured. Strapi and Payload have no canonical published image (their content model is code), so their image size stays `pending` until the app scaffolds are built. We do not guess it.

method.M-image: docker images SIZE column (uncompressed, amd64). Corroborated by the docker history layer sum. `docker image inspect --format {{.Size}}` is NOT used, because it under-reports ~5x on Docker 29.x.

entries.detail: directus/directus:11 official image, amd64, `docker images` = 1.21 GB (history layer sum 969 MB).
